topic: fix a USB printer that isn't detected by the computer
core_question: Why won't my computer recognize my printer when it's plugged in via USB? (secondary: How do I get a red wine stain out of carpet?)
answer_summary: Uninstall the existing printer driver/device, then reinstall the latest driver from the manufacturer (or use Windows Update) and reconnect the USB cable.; after the topic shift: Blot up excess wine immediately without rubbing, apply a solution of dish soap and hydrogen peroxide (or club soda), let sit, and blot repeatedly until it lifts, rinsing with cold water.
persona: skeptical and testy; writing terse one-liners
